description:
Validate a company's registered address against the official address base: France via API Adresse (Base Adresse Nationale, IGN).
Use it to check that an address exists and is the company's, or to geolocate it. Don't use it to find companies: call search_companies.
Inputs: country and identifier, as lookup_company (e.g. 'FR', '441639465').
Returns: validated (true, false or null with a reason), normalized address, BAN ids, coordinates, precision, confidence, and how many active companies share the address.
Limits: 1 unit. Spain not available yet. Read-only.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

identifier.description: Official ID, as lookup_company: FR SIREN (9 digits), SIRET or VAT; ES Registro Mercantil sheet, e.g. VI-23266. GB: Companies House company number, e.g. 00445790.
identifier.title: Identifier

name: check_address

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput

title: Validate a company's registered address
